name: Account Hacked or Compromised
description: Customers report that someone accessed or hacked their accounts.

name: Account Access and Ownership Problems
description: Customers report trouble opening or recovering accounts, account deletion, or access by someone else.

name: Logged Out with Lost Account Data
description: Customers say they cannot sign back in and have lost access to their accounts or saved music.

name: Login Problems and Missing Music
description: Customers describe login difficulties alongside lost playlists, liked songs, or other account data.

name: Phone Login and Account Creation
description: Customers report trouble logging in or creating accounts with a phone number, sometimes alongside missing playlists.

name: Account Access Across Countries
description: Customers report account access or playlist problems when accounts are used or accessed from another country.

name: Unexpected or Duplicate Subscription Charges
description: Customers describe duplicate or continued charges, lost subscription time, or missing refunds.

name: Unwanted Charges After Cancellation
description: Customers report repeated, unauthorized, or post-cancellation charges and difficulty getting money back.

name: Billing and Payment Complaints
description: Mixed billing complaints include repeated deductions, disputed charges, and concerns about plan pricing.

name: Payment Taken Without Plan Activation
description: Customers say they were charged for a plan or trial but did not receive the expected subscription.

name: Mixed Billing and Music Complaints
description: Mixed complaints mention missing songs, payment controls, charges, and other account concerns without one consistent billing problem.

name: Unexpected Payments and Premium Access
description: Customers report money being taken without receiving Premium, unexpected deductions, or related bank fees.

name: Songs Disappearing from Catalog or Favorites
description: Customers report missing songs or favorites disappearing from their collections.

name: Lyrics Missing or Not Loading
description: Customers say song lyrics are unavailable or fail to load.

name: Songs and Playlists Removed
description: Customers report songs or entire playlists disappearing from their libraries.

name: Podcasts and Library Content Missing
description: Customers say podcasts, albums, songs, or playlists are missing or will not load.

name: Listening History and Recommendations Lost
description: Customers report lost listening history, vanished playlists, or changed recommendations.

name: Missing Music Difficult to Find
description: Customers report missing playlists or songs that do not appear even when searched for.

name: Playlists and Offline Music Disappearing
description: Customers report playlists or downloaded music disappearing from their libraries.

name: Saved Songs and Playlists Disappearing
description: Customers say saved songs are unliked or playlists and other library content disappear.

name: Downloaded Music Removed or Unavailable
description: Customers report downloads being erased, removed, or requiring repeated downloads, and offline music becoming unavailable.

name: Mixed Privacy and Account Complaints
description: Mixed complaints mention privacy concerns, data collection, and missing account content.

name: Sound Output and Volume Problems
description: Customers report no sound, unusually loud playback, or trouble connecting Spotify audio to other devices.

name: Battery Drain and Slow App Performance
description: Customers describe battery drain, storage use, slow loading, or an app that rarely opens.

name: Mobile Data Use and Connectivity Concerns
description: Customers report unexpectedly high mobile data use or concerns about data consumption during playback.

name: Mixed Playback and Library Problems
description: Mixed complaints mention lost music, playback difficulties, and other concerns without one consistent playback defect.

name: Unexpected Device Connections and Playback
description: Customers report unwanted device connections, audio switching, or playback behaving unexpectedly across devices.

name: Mixed Playback and Account Glitches
description: Mixed complaints mention empty playlists, lost likes, account access, and other glitches without one specific playback defect.

name: Mixed Playback and Library Complaints
description: Mixed complaints mention lost music, missing downloads, and other problems without one specific playback defect.

name: Wrong Songs Play or Tracks Skip
description: Customers say playback skips, starts random songs, or fails to play the selected playlist or track.

name: Playback Stops or Lags Unexpectedly
description: Customers report music stopping when the screen turns off or playback lagging and stopping after a skip.

name: Songs and Playlists Will Not Play
description: Customers say songs or playlists will not play, though some examples also describe missing library content.

name: Support and Account Help Difficulties
description: Customers describe poor support, difficulty reaching help, or unresolved account and billing problems.

name: Unexpected Ads and Playlist Changes
description: Customers mention loud ads, unwanted songs added to playlists, and other mixed concerns about app behavior.

name: Unwanted Autoplay Interruptions
description: Customers report music starting or switching unexpectedly, including while they are driving.

name: Unclear or Unreliable Playback Controls
description: Customers describe unclear controls, difficulty managing playback, or accidental changes to favorites.

name: Mixed Usability and Library Complaints
description: Mixed complaints mention playlist loss, playback controls, privacy, and other usability concerns.

name: Playlists and Queue Disappearing
description: Customers report playlists or liked songs being erased or removed from their library.

name: Update-Related Library and Interface Problems
description: Customers describe missing music or unexpected changes to liked songs after using or updating the app.

name: Shuffle Plays Unwanted Songs
description: Customers report random songs being added or played instead of their selected music.
